question: Determine whether projective odd dynamics derives normalized flux, the fold law and same-event cut.

objects.definition: squared record norm divided by conserved joint odd norm

sources.source_status: integrated conditional flux and fold audit

Real rays rescale both registers together.
The complex quotient uses the aligned oscillator complex structure.

technique_plan.technique: Scale quotient and exact phase rotation
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: Test observability, directed crossing and phase loss

factor_origins: six signed coordinates with zero excluded

result.exact_expression: f=(1-D)/2; upward half-stock slope=omega*rho; complex-ray f undefined as a quotient observable
result.scope: The joint real-ray fraction has derivative Rdot/N. The oscillator complex-ray quotient erases the transfer. Real-ray dynamics retains the crossing when phase visibility is positive and leaves fold and cut authority open.

Complex rays identify f=0 and f=1
limitations: Native hinge law, reciprocal mechanical coupling, cut and Stage 2 open
